rows.note: Use this for a pack or set of playing cards; it is the default choice for this sense.

example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 ni1 fu3 paai4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the floorlike level on a ship or boat.

example.english: We stood on the deck enjoying the breeze.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 kei5 hai2 gaap3 baan2 dou6 ceoi1 fung1

rows.note: Use this for a raised, flat outdoor platform such as a patio or rooftop.

example.english: We barbecue on the rooftop deck.
example.traditional: 我哋喺屋頂個平台燒烤。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 uk1 deng2 go3 ping4 toi4 siu1 haau1

rows.note: Use this when “deck” means the ground or floor that someone falls or lies on.

example.jyutping: keoi5 dit3 zo2 hai2 dei6 min6 dou6
